page_title: KOL 0-0 MAI | FC Koln v Mainz 10/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' A pass from Marco Richter (Mainz) is intercepted by Marvin Schwabe and the move breaks down.
90+1' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
87' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
85' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
85' The corner from Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is cleared away by the defence.
84' Merveille Papela (Mainz) is the one who receives a yellow card.

83' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. FC Koln will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
83' Yellow card. Dominik Kohr (Mainz) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
81' What a shot! Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) decides to unleash a long-range missile of a shot, but his effort smashes against the left post.
79' An attempted cross from Merveille Papela (Mainz) is cleared.
78' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marco Richter (Mainz) will replace Brajan Gruda.
76' Jan Siewert has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Merveille Papela (Mainz) replacing Tom Krauss.
76' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
75' Substitution. Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Luca Waldschmidt walks off.

74' Excellent touch by Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
74' Mainz are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
71' Florian Dietz (1. FC Koln) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
70' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
66' Golden chance! Florian Dietz (1. FC Koln) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
64' Substitution. Florian Dietz (1. FC Koln) has come on for Steffen Tigges.
64' Steffen Baumgart decides to make a substitution. Dejan Ljubicic will be replaced by Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln).
61' Here's the change. Jonathan Burkardt leaves the pitch and Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) comes on as a substitute.
60' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
59' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
58' Tom Krauss (Mainz) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
58' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 0:6.
55' FC Koln seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
51' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
50' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
50' Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Daniel Batz.
49' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
48' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) is penalised for a foul. Frank Willenborg had a clear view and blows his whistle.
47' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
46' Steffen Baumgart has made a change at the break. Leart Paqarada has come on in place of Dominique Heintz (1. FC Koln).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

45' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the middle of the target. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Daniel Batz and his nice save.
43' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
43' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Mainz force their opponents to concede a corner.
42' Dominique Heintz (1. FC Koln) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
40' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
38' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) is penalised for holding. Frank Willenborg signals a set piece. A free kick has been awarded to Mainz.

34' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
34' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
34' Jeff Chabot is being substituted because of an injury. Steffen Baumgart sends Luca Kilian (1. FC Koln) on the pitch.
33' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

32' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play and Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
31' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
29' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
28' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

27' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Mainz.
25' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Phillipp Mwene (Mainz). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
25' A brilliant cross into the box finds Brajan Gruda (Mainz), who directs his header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
22' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
21' Total attempts – 1:3.

18' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Frank Willenborg blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
15' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.

13' Daniel Batz makes a brilliant save! Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!

12' FC Koln slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
9' A clumsy foul by Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) and Frank Willenborg blows his whistle.
8' A lofted cross from Silvan Widmer (Mainz) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
5' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
4' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
4' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
3' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marvin Schwabe intercepts the ball.
1' Dominique Heintz (1. FC Koln) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. FC Koln will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Frank Willenborg.
